title: Primal-Dual Representation Learning for Low-Rank Constrained MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.30756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representation learning has substantially improved the efficiency of unconstrained continuous-state Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), but its extension to Constrained MDPs (CMDPs) is difficult because the transition representation must be learned while constraint violation is controlled. In this paper, we study representation learning for low-rank CMDPs with continuous state spaces, and propose REP-PD-TEG for the soft cumulative-violation setting. In the feature learning period, the algorithm interacts with the environment using a decaying-$\epsilon$-greedy mixture execution policy, and uses the collected samples to learn transition features by maximum likelihood. Based on the learned features, it constructs uncertainty bonuses and plans with an optimistic Lagrangian objective to obtain the return policy. translated_title: 低秩约束马尔可夫决策过程的原对偶表征学习
translated_abstract: 表征学习已大幅提升了无约束连续状态马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的效率，但将其扩展到约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）十分困难，因为转移表征必须在控制约束违反的同时进行学习。本文研究了具有连续状态空间的低秩CMDP的表征学习，并针对软累积违反设置提出了REP-PD-TEG算法。在特征学习阶段，该算法使用衰减$\epsilon$-贪婪混合执行策略与环境交互，并利用收集到的样本通过最大似然方法学习转移特征。基于学习到的特征，算法构建不确定性奖励项，并通过乐观拉格朗日目标进行规划以获得回报策略。我们证明了回报策略的后悔度与软违反保证，并量化了衰减$\epsilon$-贪婪执行策略的影响。
tldr: 提出REP-PD-TEG算法，通过衰减ε-贪婪策略探索、最大似然特征学习与乐观拉格朗日规划，为连续状态空间的低秩约束MDP实现表征学习，并提供了后悔度与软约束违反的理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes REP-PD-TEG, a primal-dual representation learning algorithm for low-rank CMDPs with continuous state spaces, which combines decaying-ε-greedy exploration, maximum-likelihood feature learning, and optimistic Lagrangian planning to achieve regret and soft-violation guarantees.
